text:
oliver: First-day question: got my M2 MBP delivered, set up at home. Onboarding showed "Enrolling device" but System Settings shows no profile and FileVault is Off. Also brew install fails due to permissions. Any quick triage?
it_ops: Welcome! Did you complete setup on home wifi? DEP/automated enrollment often needs the corp network during OOBE. Can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`?
oliver: `profiles: No configuration profiles installed.` and `FileVault is Off.` macOS 13.6.
matt: Yep, same pattern. We can trigger a re-enroll if you share the serial via `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial`.
oliver: Serial C02ZZZ12345. ComputerName oliver-mbp.
mac-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Triggered DEP re-enrollment for C02ZZZ12345 at 2026-05-06T10:02:30Z.
oliver: Got a "Remote management wants to install a profile" prompt but it asked for an admin to allow. I don't have admin creds.
it_ops: Created temp admin `tmp-oliver` for 12h and sent the password via DM. Approve the profile then we'll escrow FileVault and remove the account.
oliver: Approved as tmp-oliver, profile installed. `profiles` now shows corporate MDM.
it_ops: To enable FileVault, run `sudo fdesetup enable -user oliver` or use System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault. Choose recovery key and we'll escrow it.
oliver: Ran `sudo fdesetup enable` and now `Encryption in progress`. Brew/install worked after using temp admin.
mac-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Device C02ZZZ12345 enrolled and policies applied at 2026-05-06T10:25:00Z.
it_ops: Temp admin will be removed in 12h. If you hit blocked kernel extensions (Docker/VSCode helpers), ping us and we'll push kext approvals.
oliver: All good for now, thanks everyone :rocket:
